items.coder_A: high_grade_glioma_unspecified (uncertain: pHGG 'WHO Grade 3 or 4' could be historical grade 4 glioma)
items.reason: Inclusion: 'histologically confirmed pediatric high-grade glioma (pHGG, WHO Grade 3 or 4)'. Grade 4 is explicitly allowed, there is no IDH requirement and glioblastoma is never named, which is the R7 pattern. Against this, 'pediatric high-grade glioma' and 'Diffuse Midline Glioma, H3 K27M-Mutant' are CNS5-style entities that WHO 2021 separates from glioblastoma, and R7 does not address paediatric-type HGG.

note: D31-B1 settles the population: paediatric 'WHO Grade 3 or 4' HGG is covered by D30-R7, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named/historical and the trial is included (consistent with NCT05553041). D31-A2: the H3K27-altered DMG route is optional, so the H3K27M row does not count and any_molecular_selection is false. D31-C3: atovaquone is given concurrently with RT in Stratum 1, so regimen combination stands. Priority-3 control_arm_from_other_arms: two parallel non-control strata, so 'no'. Nothing pending for XL. Harmonisation checked: no change; the H3K27M row is not linked to atovaquone (D31-A6) and stays a non-counting optional route (D31-A2, 'or' within one criterion).

revisions.reason: D31-B1 applies D30-R7 to 'pediatric high-grade glioma (pHGG, WHO Grade 3 or 4)'; age is handled at S4.
H3K27 alteration is only one optional route ('pHGG, WHO Grade 3 or 4) or diffuse midline glioma with altered H3K27'), not an entry requirement.
